intro.text: Halt! Oh, it's you, {name}. Slimes keep oozing up to the gate and my knees aren't what they used to be. Would you deal with one for me?

choices.text: You look exhausted. Rest, I'll handle it.
choices.reason: Offered to help a tired Guard Tomas
Told Tomas you were scared of slimes

accept.text: That's the spirit! They hop around the meadows east of the gate. Hit them before they hit you.

grateful.text: Bless you. Not many folk notice an old guard's tired bones. The slimes are east of the gate. Come back and tell me when it's done.

refuse.text: Hmph. It is, and I'm doing it. Badly. Forget I asked.

scared.text: Ha! They're mostly jelly. Come back when you're ready.

waiting.text: Still out there, isn't it? The slimes hop around the meadows east of the gate.

done.text: You actually did it! Here, iron ore from the old mine. A clever crafter can turn it into something sharp.

idle.text: Quiet day at the gate, thanks to you. The dark cave to the west, though? Even I don't go there.
